title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-09
content:
Exec Staff Meeting - 2026-03-09
Prepared by: Asha Patel
Collaborators: Evan Kim, Lina Torres, Michael Chen
Status: Draft (finalize agenda + asks before 2026-03-09 09:00 PT)

Goals for this sync:
- Quick alignment on Dedicated launch readiness and outstanding risks.
- Confirm Private sales commitments and next steps for onboarding pilot customers.
- Review incident follow-ups from last week (region outage) and SRE action plan.
- Agree on Q2 hiring priorities and near-term budget flex.
- Surface any critical asks for board/CEO ahead of quarterly update.

Proposed agenda (30-40m):
1) 5m - Headlines / quick wins (ops, revenue, org)
   - Dedicated: finalize GA date? current target 2026-03-18; any blockers? (Evan)
   - Private: pilot contract signed with NovaHealth? sales update (Lina)
2) 10m - Launch readiness deep dive (Evan)
   - Capacity plan vs expected demand (SLA tiers)
   - Rollout plan: canary cohorts, fallback policies, runbook readiness
   - Outstanding infra tickets: INFRA-789 (KV cache regression), INFRA-802 (autoscaler flakiness)
3) 8m - Incident postmortem & remediation (Michael/SRE)
   - Summary of region outage on 2026-03-03, customer impact, RCA status
   - Mitigations deployed, long-term mitigations backlog and prioritization
4) 7m - GTM / Sales ask (Lina)
   - Resource needs for onboarding 2 pilot customers (professional services hours)
   - Billing/pricing question for reserved capacity pilots
5) 5m - Org / People (Asha)
   - Q2 hires: prioritization for infra/SRE and product roles
   - Heads-up on candidate pipeline for lead infra eng
6) 2-3m - AOB / Decisions / Next steps

Key discussion points / notes to raise:
- Dedicated GA: engineering confidence is 80% for 2026-03-18 but we need sign-off on autoscaler fixes and at least one large-scale soak run. Request: authorize 48h burst capacity for first week of GA to reduce risk (ask to CEO).
- Private onboarding: legal has redlines on data residency clause for NovaHealth; sales needs estimated timeline for on-prem packaging (2-3 weeks?) and one SRE dedicated onboarding slot.
- Incident: root cause points to third-party network dependency + a bug in continuous batching that amplified recovery time. Short-term: blacklist affected POP and revert batching patch (done). Long-term: add additional health checks and circuit-breaker logic. Need decision on allocating 1 FTE from infra for 6 weeks to implement durable fix.
- Observability: dashboard gaps noted in token-level cost attribution for Dedicated customers; Product/Console follow-up required.

Action items (owner - due):
- Evan: run one full-scale soak (48h) on dedicated cluster and report perf numbers; confirm any perf regressions - due 2026-03-15.
- Evan & Michael: prioritize INFRA-789 and INFRA-802 into this sprint; provide ETA and rollback plan - due 2026-03-11.
- Michael (SRE): draft incident postmortem and remediation roadmap; include customer impact timeline for comms - due 2026-03-10.
- Lina: confirm NovaHealth redlines and provide final contract timeline + ask for PS hours budget - due 2026-03-12.
- Asha: prepare decision brief for CEO asking for 48h burst capacity approval and 1 FTE infra allocation; include expected cost delta - due 2026-03-10.
- Product/Console (assigned: Priya): scope small dashboard patch for token-level cost attribution and estimate lift - due 2026-03-16.

Pre-reads (please skim before meeting):
- Dedicated launch plan (Confluence) - https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/DEDICATED-LAUNCH-PLAN
- INFRA-789 ticket (KV cache regression) - Jira INFRA-789
- Ops PR for autoscaler fix - https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/432
- Incident notes (SRE) - draft PM/incident notes in channel #sre-incidents

Decisions needed at meeting:
- Approve Dedicated GA date (propose keep 2026-03-18 but allow rollback window).
- Approve temporary 48h burst capacity for GA week and a 1 FTE infra allocation for permanent fix.
- Confirm PS hours budget for NovaHealth pilot.

Open questions / risks:
- If soak run shows regression >5% RPS, do we delay GA or ship with reduced initial capacity? need contingency discussion.
- Legal redlines for NovaHealth may require changes to private package - estimate impact on timeline.
- Hiring: lead infra candidate timeline might slip into late Q2; contingency to move contractor support?

Notes to self / follow-ups after meeting:
- Capture decisions in Confluence and update launch checklist. Link decisions to tickets (INFRA-789/802).
- If CEO approves burst capacity, coordinate with cloud ops to enable and confirm cost center tagging.
- Ask SRE to prepare customer-facing incident timeline for affected customers and CS to lead comms.

Quick personal checklist before meeting:
- Send final agenda to execs + CEO by 2026-03-09 08:30 PT (Asha)
- Attach the three pre-reads to the calendar invite (Evan)
- Confirm Lina has contract redline summary ready (Lina)

End of prep notes.
